newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco finds bodies of 15 flood victims.
newsitem.headline: Morocco finds bodies of 15 flood victims.

text.p: Fifteen bodies have been recovered from flood waters south of Rabat following an accident last week when a bus was swept away, an Interior Ministry committee said on Friday.

Rescue workers saved 52 people from the bus whose driver did not notice a diversion sign put up to warn of flood waters, said the committee, reported by the official Moroccan news agency MAP. It said the bus driver had been arrested.

Much of Morocco has been swept by heavy rains since early December and a total of 41 people have died. Some drowned, others were killed by collapsing houses, and other electrocuted, the committee said.
